desc: Prove that `abs(len(S) - len(T)) > K` makes conversion impossible.
Design the banded edit-distance recurrence for insertion, deletion, and replacement operations.
Derive and implement the furthest-reaching diagonal (Myers/Ukkonen) algorithm, including greedy matching and unequal-length boundary handling.
Validate sample cases and key edge cases: equal strings, unequal lengths, exact-distance cases, and no-match cases.
Produce the final stdin/stdout Python solution with practical complexity for lengths up to 500000 and `K <= 20`.
